_comment: Curated overrides. Order of 'featured' = display order. Repos not listed here still appear automatically under 'More repositories' (non-fork, public). Add a repo name to 'hidden' to drop it.

featured.title: Dukaan Saathi
featured.blurb: AI business partner for Paytm merchants, delivered through the Soundbox on the counter. Reads payment history, picks the one action worth taking today, says it aloud in the shopkeeper's language, and reports what it earned. Paytm Build for India AI Hackathon, Merchant Growth AI track.

featured.title: Cold Storage Monitor
featured.blurb: IoT system for onion cold storage: an ESP32 tracks temperature, humidity and decay gases in real time, with a live cloud dashboard, TFT display, LEDs and buzzer alerts.

featured.title: Scheme Saathi
featured.blurb: Voice-first assistant that finds Indian government schemes for people in their own language (Hindi, Kannada and more).

featured.title: Grievance Swarm
featured.blurb: Campus complaint system where memory-backed AI agents route and remember grievances, while staff make the final call.

featured.title: BreatheWise
featured.blurb: Tells a school which outdoor periods to move indoors on bad-air days, from its timetable and the hourly air forecast. Runs on AWS.

featured.title: Live Captions
featured.blurb: Real-time Hindi and English live captions, powered by Gnani Prisma v3.0.

featured.title: KoshSetu
featured.blurb: Security deposit and FDR portal, prototype for Smart India Hackathon problem statement SIH26265.

featured.title: Pacer
featured.blurb: AI productivity companion that prioritises your tasks and nudges you toward action instead of only reminding you. Built with Gemini in Google AI Studio.

featured.title: Pi Barcode Scanner
featured.blurb: Raspberry Pi 4 and Camera Module 3 that act as a USB keyboard: scan a barcode and the text is typed into any app on the host computer via USB HID.

featured.title: Air-Draw
featured.blurb: Touchless drawing app. Pinch thumb and index finger to draw in the air, tracked with OpenCV and MediaPipe hand landmarks.

featured.title: GitBounty
featured.blurb: Open-source work, rewarded when it ships: sign in with GitHub, earn points as your PRs are merged, climb the leaderboards.

featured.title: ManchX
featured.blurb: Student-only campus hub with live events and hackathons, a social feed, messaging, and an admin dashboard for societies.
